dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I picked this up earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Did you, now? Some idiot must have lost it along the way again. Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Acat
dialogues.text: Yeah, this one's mine. Someone from the Children of Echoes wanted to purchase paints, but couldn't tell me what colors he wanted to save his life.

dialogues.speaker: Acat
dialogues.text: That's why I sent him a package with several small bottles of paint in it — so he could get his preferences straight before he next shows up.

dialogues.speaker: Acat
dialogues.text: I'll get this resent — better that than him coming over here with his ridiculous reference requests...

dialogues.speaker: Acat
dialogues.text: Ah, right. This is for you. Thanks for getting this package back to me.

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: Huh? Yeah, this is my order. Didn't think it would meet with such bad luck...

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: Oh well. I'll just have to write another later. This isn't super urgent, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Chanca
dialogues.text: Anyway, thanks for bringing the letter back to me. You're sweating all over — here, have a drink on me.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Yeah, this one's mine — it's the package I sent out!

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Oh, thank goodness, I thought I'd sent it off to the wrong address... I'd be smoked if that was the case!

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Thank you, truly! Please, take these.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Also, uh... Could you not tell Ms. Cheven about this? I'm begging you!

dialogues.speaker: Tirda
dialogues.text: ...Yes. This letter's mine. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Tirda
dialogues.text: I'll write a new one soon. Then I'll get someone to send it to the Flower-Feather Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Tirda
dialogues.text: ...I hope this next one makes it there safely.

dialogues.speaker: Tirda
dialogues.text: Here, you've earned this.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Looks like... it's for Acat.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: ...The packaging's broken. If we resend it as-is, the whole item might get ruined.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help me send this to her?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: She's the owner of Frida's Palette. Don't worry, you couldn't miss her shop's sign even if you tried.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: This... looks like Chanca's handwriting.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: If I had to guess, this must be another order invoice. The packaging here is broken — there's no way we can deliver it this way. This letter shall have to be returned.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help send this back to Chanca in my stead?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: She's the owner of the Weary Inn near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. You can't miss it.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Muhuru's Gemporium... Imix? Agh, this is an invoice she sent out, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: If this gets lost in transit, that kid's going to get an earful from Ms. Cheven.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help me send this back to Imix?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Muhuru's Gemporium is in the Children of Echoes' lands — and it's an easy find if ever there was one.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: ...This letter's from Tirda, if I'm not mistaken.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Was she trying to get it sent to her tribe? But it's a mess now... We're going to have to return it.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help get this back to Tirda in my stead?

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: She sings at the Golden Dusk. You'll find her in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the package we're looking for...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here about this missing package...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here about this missing letter...
